title: تقييم لتطبيق
body:
على حسب تجربتي مع بنك ابوظبي الاول والبنوك الاخرى تبين لي السلبيات التالية:-

- تاخير في عمليات التحويل من بنك الى بنك اخر عكس عمليات التحويل في البنوك الاخرى التي تتم في نفس اليوم.
- بعد ان يتم خصم القسط الشهري يتم الحجز على المبلغ او الراتب المتبقي لمدة يوم كامل.
- تأخير في جميع الطلبات لاسرجاع للمبالغ الزائدة في بطاقات الائتمان او طلب شهادات.

اما ايجابيات التطبيق هي:

- سهل وبسيط ومفهوم وواضح 
- آمن
- تتوفر فيه جميع انوع دفع الفواتير والمستحقات
- الاطلاع على القروض ومعرفة تاريخ الاستحقاق والمبلغ المستحق وغيرها
- يمكن للمتعامل تقديم طلبات عبر التطبيق دون زيارة الفرع.

ولهذا عن تجربتي الشخصية تقيمي للبنك والتطبيق مقبول كون هناك تطبيقات وبنوك اخرى افضل بكثير.

title: FAB provides bad service for the low salaried individual
body:
Maybe the bank provide good services for the rich, but what is sure is this bank treats low salary individuals very poorly, requesting a service from the branch or online leads always to a bad experience, process time very slow and incompetent agents (not all of them of course) but the ones i meet are definitely.
I tried complaining about the matter 3 times via email i received a text message saying they tried to contact me but i was out of reach, first time i said maybe its true but after 2nd and 3rd time i was sure they do it in purpose because as i said on the opening of this review they treat low salary individual very poorly and my profile was worth their time to hear my complaint, i tried via call center they put me on hold for more than 46 min(i have a screen shot of the call as proof) when the agent finally answered i told them i was on hold for more then 46 min they said no way we answer right away i didnt bother to argue because i know they treat low salaried individuals poorly.
This all to say FAB should work more on providing a fair service to all.

title: The worst banking app and service ever
body:
I happened to be a FAB client because of my employer. I have been using the app since October 2022. So my top-5 concerns are:

1) Almost 50% of the time the app is under maintenance. Which is unacceptable. Whenever you want to make a maintenance do it during the night time, but not when people have to make the money transfers and etc.

2) When it is not under maintenance periodically when you need to do a money transfer even between your own accounts it just doesn’t work. 

3) The credit card interface is terribly flawed. When you make yourself a credit card payment it doesn’t show simultaneously that the card was paid. However the card limit available to spend increases by this amount. Frankly speaking, it is horribly misleading. 

4) FAB Etihad earned guest miles calculation - it is just a disaster. In the app right now it shows for me minus 639. When in fact I have been using the card since March, and have never redeemed the miles. What is the purpose of this widget if it doesn’t help at all???

5) The app is annoyingly slow.. It is not a mobile banking app at all if it is so slow in opening. 

I can keep on with the list forever, but now I would like to add some comments about the customer support which works very poorly:

1) I’m on a business trip in another country and I needed to reach the bank. I have been trying to reach the support via the number indicated at the website during the whole day. And nobody picked up the phone.

2) Whenever you write any inquiries (the urgent ones, as the phone line doesn’t work) to Atyourservice at bankfab dot com you are lucky if they reply you in a week.

To sum up, if I had a choice I would never use FAB. Disrespectful and flawed service. Change your attitude to the customer support and completely change your product and developers teams to the people who obtain a common sense and at least understand that doing maintenance during the business hours is a disaster. 

Best regards,

Nika

title: Extremely Disappointed with FAB Bank's Poor Service and Rude Customer Support
body: I have been a loyal customer of FAB Bank for the past five years, but my recent experience with them has been nothing short of a nightmare. Not only are they making it unnecessarily difficult for me to close my cards for personal reasons, but their customer service agent's rude and unsupportive behavior has left me extremely disappointed. Firstly, I reached out to FAB Bank to initiate the closure of my cards. Instead of providing me with a straightforward process to follow, they seemed to go out of their way to make it as complicated as possible. It feels like they are intentionally delaying the process, causing unnecessary frustration and inconvenience. As a long-term customer, I expected better treatment and a smoother experience when closing my accounts. To add insult to injury, the customer service agent who contacted me regarding my request was shockingly rude and unhelpful. Their lack of empathy and understanding was appalling. Instead of offering assistance or attempting to address my concerns, the agent displayed an unprofessional attitude and seemed more interested in rushing me off the call. It's truly disheartening to be treated with such disrespect after years of loyalty to this bank. As a customer, I value respectful and supportive communication. Unfortunately, FAB Bank failed to deliver on both fronts. The behavior of their customer service representative reflects poorly on the bank's overall commitment to customer satisfaction. If this is the level of service they provide to their long-standing customers, I can only imagine how they treat new customers or handle more complex issues. I urge potential customers to think twice before choosing FAB Bank as their banking partner. While my review may be based on a single incident, the lack of professionalism and courtesy displayed by their staff is indicative of a larger problem within the organization. Banking should be a positive experience, with reliable support and respectful treatment. Regrettably, FAB Bank falls short on these essential aspects, leaving customers feeling frustrated, undervalued, and disenchanted. In conclusion, I am deeply disappointed with FAB Bank's poor service and the rude behavior exhibited by their customer service agent. As a result, I have decided to sever ties with the bank and find a financial institution that values its customers and treats them with the respect they deserve
